strategies.name: Auto-trader (live rules)
strategies.desc: Buys top-ranked stocks (score ≥ 0.5) in an uptrend with RSI < 70. Target +1.5× and stop −0.75× the stock's monthly move, stop to breakeven after +1×, max 21 trading days, sell if score < 0.

strategies.name: Auto-trader, wider exits
strategies.desc: Buys top-ranked stocks (score ≥ 0.5) in an uptrend with RSI < 70. Target +3.0× and stop −1.5× the stock's monthly move, stop to breakeven after +1×, max 21 trading days, sell if score < 0.

strategies.name: EMA 9/21 cross + RSI
strategies.desc: Same rules as strategy.pine: buy when EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 with RSI < 70; sell on the cross back down, 3% stop, 6% target.

strategies.name: Momentum rotation (top 10)
strategies.desc: Every 21 trading days, hold the 10 stocks with the best 12-month return excluding the last month. No stops.

strategies.name: RSI(2) dip-buy
strategies.desc: Buys short, sharp dips in uptrends: price above its 200-day average and 2-day RSI < 10. Sells when price closes above its 5-day average, or after 10 days.

strategies.name: Pairs: buy the laggard
strategies.desc: For 15 same-industry pairs, when the price ratio is > 2 std devs from its 60-day mean, buy the laggard. Sell when the gap closes (|z| < 0.5), after 20 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: Breakout: 20-day high (turtle)
strategies.desc: Buys when a stock closes above its highest close of the last 20 days; sells when it closes below its lowest close of the last 10 days. Classic trend-following.

strategies.name: Trend: 50-day above 200-day
strategies.desc: Holds stocks whose 50-day average is above their 200-day average (a 'golden cross' uptrend); sells when it drops below. Strongest momentum first.

strategies.name: Bollinger band dip-buy
strategies.desc: In stocks above their 200-day average, buys a close below the lower Bollinger band (20-day average minus 2 std devs); sells back at the 20-day average, after 10 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: MACD cross (in uptrends)
strategies.desc: Buys when MACD (12/26) crosses above its 9-day signal line while the stock is above its 200-day average; sells on the cross back down.

strategies.name: Momentum rotation + market filter
strategies.desc: Same as momentum rotation, but moves everything to cash whenever the S&P 500 is below its 200-day average (to dodge bear markets).

strategies.name: Low volatility (10 calmest)
strategies.desc: Every 21 trading days, holds the 10 stocks with the lowest 1-year volatility. A defensive factor strategy.

strategies.name: 52-week high breakout + 10% trailing stop
strategies.desc: Buys stocks closing at a new 52-week high; rides them with a stop 10% below the highest close since entry, for up to 60 days.

strategies.name: Weekly losers bounce
strategies.desc: Every 5 days, buys the 10 stocks that fell the most over the past week (only if still above their 200-day average) and holds them 5 days.

strategies.name: Swing: 3 down days in an uptrend
strategies.desc: Buys a stock above its 200-day average after 3 lower closes in a row; sells when it closes above the previous day's high, after 7 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: Swing: 7-day low / 7-day high
strategies.desc: Buys a stock above its 200-day average when it closes at a 7-day low; sells when it closes at a 7-day high, or after 15 days.

strategies.name: Swing: buy pullbacks in leaders
strategies.desc: Among the 20 highest-scoring stocks, buys one that dips below its 21-day EMA while staying above its 50-day average; sells when it makes a new 10-day high, after 15 days, or at a 7% stop.

strategies.name: Swing: tight-range (NR7) breakout
strategies.desc: In uptrends (price > 50-day > 200-day), after the narrowest daily range of the last 7 days, buys a close above that day's high. 6% target, 3% stop, 10 days max.

strategies.name: Swing: Bollinger squeeze breakout
strategies.desc: When a stock's Bollinger bands are the tightest in 6 months and it closes above the upper band, buys; sells on a close below the 20-day average, after 20 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: Swing: RSI(2) dips in strong stocks
strategies.desc: Like the RSI(2) dip-buy, but only in the 30 highest-scoring stocks: buys when 2-day RSI < 10, sells on a close above the 5-day average or after 10 days.

strategies.name: Short: 7-day high in a downtrend
strategies.desc: Mirror of the 7-day low/high swing: shorts a stock below its 200-day average when it closes at a 7-day high; covers at a 7-day low, or after 15 days.

strategies.name: Long/short: 7-day low & high
strategies.desc: Runs both sides at once: buys 7-day lows in uptrends and shorts 7-day highs in downtrends. Exits at the opposite 7-day extreme or after 15 days.

strategies.name: Long/short momentum (10 long, 10 short)
strategies.desc: Every 21 trading days: long the 10 best 12-month performers, short the 10 worst. Roughly market-neutral.

strategies.name: Short: 20-day low breakdown
strategies.desc: Shorts a stock below its 200-day average when it closes under its lowest close of the last 20 days; covers on a close above its 10-day high, after 20 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: Short: overbought pops in downtrends
strategies.desc: Shorts a stock below its 200-day average when its 2-day RSI is above 90; covers on a close below its 5-day average, or after 10 days.

strategies.name: Pairs: long laggard / short leader
strategies.desc: Classic pairs trade on 15 same-industry pairs: when the price ratio is > 2 std devs from its 60-day mean, buys the laggard AND shorts the leader. Both legs close when |z| < 0.5, after 20 days, or at an 8% stop.

strategies.name: Buy & hold every stock (equal weight)
strategies.desc: Benchmark: buy every stock in the list on day one in equal amounts and never trade again.

strategies.name: S&P 500 (SPY)
strategies.desc: Benchmark: the whole market, buy and hold. No costs.

strategies.name: Opening range breakout (30 min)
strategies.desc: Buys when price breaks above the first 30 minutes' high; stop at the 30-minute low; out at the close.

strategies.name: Opening range breakout + uptrend filter
strategies.desc: Same, but only for stocks that closed above their 50-day average the day before.

strategies.name: Opening range breakout (15 min)
strategies.desc: Faster version: breakout of the first 15 minutes' high, stop at the 15-minute low.

strategies.name: VWAP reclaim
strategies.desc: After 10:00, buys when a stock that's up on the day crosses back above its VWAP; sells if it falls back below, or at the close.

strategies.name: Gap-down fade (buy the gap)
strategies.desc: Buys at the open when a stock in a long-term uptrend opens 2%+ below yesterday's close, betting the gap fills. 3% stop, out at the close.

strategies.name: Gap-and-go
strategies.desc: When a stock opens 2%+ above yesterday's close and the first 5 minutes are green, buys and holds to the close. Stop at the first bar's low.

strategies.name: Intraday RSI(2) dip-buy
strategies.desc: On green days, buys 5-minute dips (2-bar RSI < 10) and sells the bounce (RSI > 70) or at the close. Can trade several times a day.

strategies.name: Last-hour momentum
strategies.desc: At 3:00 pm, buys stocks up 1%+ on the day and above VWAP; sells at the close.

strategies.name: Short: opening range breakdown (30 min)
strategies.desc: Shorts when price breaks below the first 30 minutes' low; stop at the 30-minute high; covers at the close.

strategies.name: Short: opening range breakdown + downtrend
strategies.desc: Same, only for stocks that closed below their 50-day average the day before.

strategies.name: Long/short opening range (trend-aligned)
strategies.desc: Long the 30-minute breakout in uptrending stocks, short the 30-minute breakdown in downtrending ones.

strategies.name: Short: gap-up fade in downtrends
strategies.desc: Shorts at the open when a stock below its 200-day average gaps up 2%+, betting the gap fills. 3% stop, covers at the close.

strategies.name: Short: VWAP rejection
strategies.desc: After 10:00, shorts a stock that's down on the day when it falls back below VWAP; covers if it gets back above, or at the close.

strategies.name: Short: last-hour weakness
strategies.desc: At 3:00 pm, shorts stocks down 1%+ on the day and below VWAP; covers at the close.

strategies.name: SPY open-to-close (baseline)
strategies.desc: Baseline: buy the S&P 500 ETF at every open, sell at every close. What 'just being in the market during the day' earns.

strategies.name: S&P 500 held (incl. overnight)
strategies.desc: Benchmark: buy SPY on the first day and hold through the whole period. No costs.
